name: infra
description: Terraform root with representative AWS modules and one infra workflow with plan/apply modes.

variables.name: STACK_NAME
variables.description: Stack name. Prefixes every AWS resource name.

variables.name: OWNER
variables.description: Backstage group name of the team owning this infrastructure.

variables.name: REPOSITORY
variables.description: Repository the scaffold lands in, as owner/name.

variables.name: STATE_BUCKET
variables.description: Existing S3 bucket holding Terraform state.

variables.name: TOOLKIT_REPOSITORY
variables.description: Repository hosting the modules and reusable lanes.

variables.name: TOOLKIT_REF
variables.description: Published toolkit release tag or full commit SHA. No floating branches.

variables.name: REPOSITORY_BASE_URL
variables.description: Git hosting base URL for source links. Delivery workflows currently target GitHub.
